data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Samuel total 17, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.

tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Shemuʾel: shama, 'heard', + El, 'God' — 'God has heard'. Its root is Hebrew sh-m-ʿ-ʾ-l. The prophet Samuel (1 Samuel 1). Samuel is a Hebrew name meaning “God has heard”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
